Nepal landslide causes river to swell, threatening downstream areas

A large landslide caused a mountain to collapse into the Narayani river in Nepal, leading the river to cross its danger level. The swelling river poses a risk to areas downstream, including along the Gandak region. The event occurred in Nepal.
